name: K-Spot Now Quality Council
mission: Ship a visitor-grade Korea event platform that can stand beside official tourism, shopping, and brand websites by enforcing source accuracy, design quality, publishing hygiene, and CEO task dispatch before launch.

benchmarks.name: VISITKOREA
benchmarks.standard: Official multilingual Korea travel platform with destination discovery, practical visitor information, campaigns, and trusted source posture.

benchmarks.name: Korea Tourism Organization
benchmarks.standard: Institutional trust, official tourism authority context, and reliable public-facing information.

benchmarks.name: OLIVE YOUNG Global
benchmarks.standard: High-intent foreign shopper experience with strong campaign imagery, clear product/event entry points, and mobile commerce polish.

benchmarks.name: Visit Seoul
benchmarks.standard: City-level visitor information, event discovery, and travel-ready context.

roles.name: CEO
roles.responsibility: Own final quality target, review audit comments, approve release only after hard gates pass, and assign new tasks from warnings.

roles.name: Planner
roles.responsibility: Own visitor intent, event coverage, source expansion, route usefulness, and content priorities.

roles.name: Designer
roles.responsibility: Own visual hierarchy, carousel behavior, imagery, responsive composition, readability, and benchmark-level polish.

roles.name: Publisher
roles.responsibility: Own production variables, sitemap, feeds, policy pages, Cloudflare deploy readiness, and Search/AdSense hygiene.

roles.name: Audit Institution
roles.responsibility: Independently verify facts, source trust, translation presence, thumbnail provenance, high-risk event dates, and release readiness.

releasePolicy.hardFailRule: Any failed audit item blocks release until the responsible department fixes it and the audit institution re-runs the review.
releasePolicy.warningRule: Warnings block an AdSense review release. Optional monetization setup notes must be recorded as informational passes; unresolved content, trust, freshness, CMP, SEO, or UX warnings require rework and a second audit.
